sophie: Quick heads-up — Vendor-Omega pinged: 6x A100-40GB available in eu-west1 for ~48h. Anyone planning to run canary or smoke tests?
ana: Nice, that could cover the perf canary for the optimizer PR. What window do we have exactly?
mike: ETA window shows until Tue 08:00 UTC per their note. Might be first-come.
rahul: If we grab them we should bake AMI + TF changes now. I can start AMI bake at 22:00 UTC.
sophie: @rahul SGTM. Can you also add a short manifest so billing tags get applied?
rahul: Will do. Patch in progress — adding tag `redwood:purpose=canary` and `owner=eng-infra`.
karen: Heads-up — infra-oncall will need the slot id to whitelist in our tenant allocation. Can vendor-bot dump the slot id here? :pray:
vendor-bot: Reservation available. Slot ID: omega-eu-42a7. Valid until 2026-03-23T08:00:00Z. Use `reserve --slot omega-eu-42a7 --project redwood-demo` to claim.
mike: @vendor-bot thanks. I'll run the reserve command in 5m and then ping when done.
(mike runs command)
mike: Done — reserved `omega-eu-42a7`. Starting AMI bake in ~10. tagging and terraform PR incoming.
sophie: awesome, thanks. If anything blocks, @ana please escalate to procurement.
ana: will do. also putting a note in the capacity spreadsheet so PMs see it. :spiral_notepad:
rahul: I'll attach the small TF diff to the PR with the tags and permission changes. ETA ~ +30m.
